name: Kagome Co., Ltd.
summary: Kagome Co., Ltd. is involved in the manufacturing, purchasing, and sale of vegetable drinks and food products in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Domestic Processed Food Business, International Business, and Others. The Domestic Processed Food Business segment manufactures and sells beverages, preserved food, seasonings, and other products. The International Business segment engages in seed, seedling, and farming product development, processing, and sale activities. The Others segment offers tomato paste, diced tomatoes, carrot juice, frozen Mediterranean vegetables, pizza sauce, barbecue sauce, and tomato ketchup.
